{{Top|leg}}
The '''Naval Crypt''' was a chamber beneath the [[Twelve Mounts]] on [[Prefsbelt IV/Legends|Prefsbelt IV]]. Connected to [[Castle Pradeux]] by a long passage, it was the tomb of the body of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Pers Pradeux]], the "Father of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]]". [[Midshipman/Legends|Midshipmen]] passing out from the [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Prefsbelt Naval Academy]] would travel to the Crypt the night before graduation to dedicate themselves to the naval service.<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
